page: Microsoft Azure NV18ads_A10_v5 is a virtual machine instance within the NVADSA10v5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This server features 18 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD processor. It is equipped with 220.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.22 GB per vCPU.

The instance includes a fractional GPU allocation of 0.5 NVIDIA A10 GPU, providing 11 GB of dedicated VRAM. For local storage, the server is provisioned with a 737 GB local SSD and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The fractional GPU configuration represents a specific tradeoff, offering entry-level GPU acceleration without the cost of a full dedicated GPU, which increases cost efficiency for workloads that do not fully saturate a whole A10 chip. The high memory capacity relative to the vCPU count makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, virtual desktop infrastructure, and moderate graphics rendering or machine learning inference tasks.
